get.summary: WMTS capabilities or image-local raster tile
get.description: Asset-local pixel matrices, not geographic slippy-map coordinates. Each output tile is at most 512 pixels per edge. GetTile requires LAYER, TILEMATRIXSET, TILEMATRIX, TILEROW and TILECOL. DRIVER selects source decoder; FORMAT selects output encoder. Response timing headers are milliseconds. Cache hits may use lossless HTJ2K; original file identity is unchanged.

parameters.name: LAYER

schema.description: Canonical asset identity; GetCapabilities also accepts an opaque S3 locator for lazy selection.

parameters.description: Required canonical identity for GetTile. Optional GetCapabilities selector for one image with actual header metadata.

parameters.name: LIMIT
parameters.description: GetCapabilities page size when LAYER is omitted; bounded to 1-100 registered assets.

parameters.name: CURSOR
parameters.description: GetCapabilities continuation from X-River-Next-Cursor. Provider object listings are not crawled.

parameters.name: LAYERS
parameters.description: Optional OpenJPEG/JP2Grok quality-layer limit. Zero or omission means full quality; the count must not exceed the source layers. NVIDIA layer selection is unsupported.

parameters.name: TILEMATRIXSET
parameters.description: GetTile: RiverPixel-<asset identity>.

parameters.name: TILEMATRIX
parameters.description: GetTile: 0 is coarsest; resolutionLevels-1 is full resolution.

parameters.name: EDGE
parameters.description: Edge tile shape: crop returns natural dimensions; black and transparent pad to the nominal tile dimensions. WebSocket previews use their native preview tile size; final tiles use 512 pixels. WMTS also accepts lowercase edge.

get.summary: WMTS tiles using a streamer URL template
get.description: Connected S3 object URLs, locators and asset IDs are accepted without manifest requests. URL-encode the complete image value once as an outer query value. Without geometry parameters, uses existing River 512-pixel WMTS matrix semantics. Explicit geometry requires tileSize and maxZoom together: sourceSpan = tileSize * 2^(maxZoom-z), bitmapEdge = round(tileSize * tilePixelRatio). minZoom defaults to 0 and tilePixelRatio to 1. Rows increase downward. Native JP2 reductions only optimize decoding; output is resampled as needed. Black/transparent padding follows scaling; crop clips to image bounds. Existing WMTS/WebSocket semantics are unchanged. When no geometry overrides are supplied, tiles are256pixels at ratio1; maxzoom=max(0,ceil(log2(max(width,height)/256))) and minzoom=0, exactly matching /api/tiles/{image}. Use that tile-info endpoint or an external service with the identical policy. Explicit geometry overrides and WMTS remain unchanged. edge=transparent returns fixed-size tiles with transparent padding.

parameters.name: z
parameters.description: Zoom increases toward full resolution. With no geometry overrides, use minzoom/maxzoom from /api/tiles/{image}; otherwise use the explicit minZoom/maxZoom.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: Tile column.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: Tile row.

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: URL-encoded S3 URI or HTTP object URL on exactly one connected S3 source, or an existing River asset ID/S3 locator. Headers are opened lazily; source images are unchanged.

parameters.name: layers
parameters.description: Optional source quality-layer limit, as for WMTS.

parameters.name: edge
parameters.description: crop keeps visible dimensions; black and transparent pad to the nominal bitmap edge. Default compatibility tiles are256pixels. Explicit geometry sets round(tileSize*tilePixelRatio). WMTS and WebSocket geometry are unchanged.

parameters.name: tileSize
parameters.description: Full-resolution source tile footprint. Required with maxZoom.

parameters.name: maxZoom
parameters.description: Client full-resolution zoom, independent of native JP2 resolution count. Required with tileSize.

parameters.name: minZoom
parameters.description: Lowest accepted zoom; must not exceed maxZoom.

parameters.name: tilePixelRatio
parameters.description: Bitmap density, independent of source coverage. Rounded bitmap edge must be 1..4096.

200.description: Encoded tile, with the same timing and cache headers as WMTS.

get.summary: Pixel pyramid metadata for a connected original image URL
get.description: Percent-encode the entire original image URL as one path segment. No client-side asset registration or bucket listing. bounds=[0,height,width,0], minzoom=0, maxzoom=ceil(log2(max(width,height)/256)) clamped below at0; dimensions above2^31 pixels require explicit multi-root geometry. Default streamer tiles use this same256px pyramid at pixel ratio1. This is a pixel grid, not geographic metadata.

parameters.name: image
parameters.description: Percent-encoded original s3:// or HTTP object URL matching exactly one configured source; registered asset IDs and River locators also work.

supportedDecoderDrivers.description: Coding-compatible driver IDs for a probed asset. Runtime availability is reported by /api/drivers; source-layout limits still apply.

assetId.description: Content SHA-256 or explicit filev/S3 version identity; version selection does not hash the complete source.

referenceOrigin.description: JPEG 2000 codestream canvas origin. All River viewport/tile coordinates remain relative to the image, independent of this origin.

assetId.description: Local content SHA-256 or s3v-prefixed S3 object-version identity; S3 selection does not hash the complete source.

maxRetries.description: Retries after the initial request;0 disables retries. Applies to SDK and native range reads, persists with the source. Omission uses RIVER_S3_MAX_RETRIES or2. Retry windows remain bounded by operation deadlines.

ServerTiming.description: Per-frame timings. elapsedMs includes previous work within this request; nested durations must not be added blindly.

TileFrameHeader.description: UTF-8 JSON header in every RIVR binary WebSocket frame.

serialTransport.description: Persisted serial range transport. Auto uses native only after sustained isolated unindexed discovery on a fast source and retains SDK under contention; force curl explicitly bypasses this selection policy. Batched payloads retain SDK.

maxSourceRequests.description: Shared in-flight range operation limit across images on each connected source. API setting persists; otherwise RIVER_S3_SOURCE_MAX_REQUESTS or 16. SDK retries remain within the acquired operation slot.

refreshPayloadCosts.description: Optional adaptive-mode mature-profile refresh before predicted overfetch. Uses a small already-required payload range to measure current throughput. Default false; RIVER_S3_REFRESH_PAYLOAD_COSTS supplies the environment default. API values persist and override it. Trades steady fast-source latency for protection against sudden bandwidth drops.
